map.文字转横幅是做什么的？: What does Text to Banner do?
map.如何使用文字转横幅？: How do I use Text to Banner?
map.文字转横幅适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Text to Banner best for?
map.终端/社媒大字：把文字转成 figlet 风格大字母横幅，做欢迎语或分隔。: Terminal/social large text: turn words into figlet-style big-letter banners for greetings or dividers.
map.命令行输出装饰：在脚本输出加醒目标题。: Command-line output decoration: add eye-catching headings to script output.
map.输入「HI」选标准字体，得到由字符拼成的大写 HI 横幅，复制到终端或 READ: Input "HI" and pick the standard font to get a big-letter HI banner made of characters; copy it to a terminal or the top of a README as a heading — more striking than plain text.
map.传统 figlet 字体多为拉丁字母，中文需专门点阵字体；本工具对中文可能逐字用: Traditional figlet fonts are mostly Latin letters; Chinese needs dedicated bitmap fonts. This tool may replace Chinese char-by-char with boxes or fall back, so for banners use pinyin/English.
map.内置若干经典字体（standard/banner/small 等），复杂字体在某: Several classic built-in fonts (standard/banner/small, etc.); complex fonts may render oddly at some terminal widths, so preview before choosing.
map.趣味海报：用 ASCII 大字做轻量视觉。: Fun posters: use ASCII Art for lightweight visuals.
